title: Type the catch clause in CurriculumImportService._activateOne so Error subtypes aren't swallowed as activation failures
why: A bare `catch (e)` also catches Error subtypes (StateError, TypeError, a failed assertion). A genuine programming bug during activation is silently reported to the onboarding UI as an ordinary 'this curriculum failed to activate' result instead of surfacing as a crash, masking the real defect behind a plausible-looking user-facing failure. (This bare-catch pattern recurs ~54 times repo-wide; only this batch's site is counted here.)
recommendation: Narrow to `on Exception catch (e)` (or the specific exception types _activationService.activate can throw) and let Error subtypes propagate.
acceptance_criteria: A test that makes the mocked activationService throw a StateError confirms it propagates out of _activateOne/importSingle instead of becoming a CurriculumImportResult(success: false)
